content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The one-compile rule fixes a single schema compilation per process and a check that accepts text; the license check reads the crossing invariant, S2-validate's checking point, and D1d's carried schema, and names any element the rule contradicts. Review form: the criterion is applied to the rule's text; nothing runs.
